title: External Provenance Lock
description: Resolution artifact for external capability content. Maps stable capability ID → source ID → requested/resolved immutable state. See docs/adr/0001-capability-declaration-and-external-provenance-lock.md. This file is downstream of SKILL.md / capability declarations; do not make it a second capability catalog.

version.description: Lock format version. v1 (upstreams[]) is deprecated; v2 is capabilities->{sources->{requested, resolved}} minimal resolution.

capabilities.description: Sparse map: only capabilities with origin: upstream and external content. first-party capabilities MUST NOT appear. First-party with external inspiration (awesome-copilot/OWASP/blog) also omitted — references belong in docs, not lock.

sources.description: Source set for one logical capability. Single-source uses one key (conventionally 'upstream'); multi-source uses per-role keys (wrapper, rules). Update of any source atomically bumps the capability provenance digest.

repository.description: GitHub owner/repo for the external source.

path.description: Path within repository to the capability artifact (e.g. skills/frontend-design).

requested.description: Declaration intent — what the capability declaration (SKILL.md) requested. Presence enables declaration↔lock drift detection.

type.description: commit: tracking a 40-char SHA; tag: tracking a semver/release tag (requires resolved.commit).

ref.description: Requested ref: 40-char SHA when type=commit, semver tag when type=tag. Mutable tracking refs (main) MUST NOT appear as resolved, only here for discovery.

resolved.description: Immutable resolution — the exact artifact that was fetched and vendored.

commit.description: Resolved 40-char commit SHA — the only immutable Git identity.

content_checksum.description: sha256 of vendored content (SKILL.md bytes for single-file vendoring; directory hash for multi-file — documented per source).

body_checksum.description: sha256 of the SKILL.md body after the closing --- fence (byte-identical to upstream body at resolved commit). Required for vendored SKILL.md fidelity. For non-SKILL artifacts (e.g. command.md rules), equals content_checksum of the whole file.

tree_sha.description: Optional Git tree SHA for the resolved path (useful for directory vendoring).

version.description: Human version for display (tag or short SHA). Not authoritative.

license.description: Observed license at resolution time. Declaration's expected_license is policy; this is evidence.

spdx.description: Observed SPDX expression at resolved commit.

source_path.description: Path to LICENSE file observed (e.g. LICENSE.txt).

checksum.description: sha256 of LICENSE file bytes if vendored.

provenance_digest.description: Deterministic digest of this capability's resolved source set: hash(source IDs + resolved commits + content_checksum + license spdx). Used for trust.reviewed_provenance binding; any source change must change this digest.
